Qualification: The general statement does not authenticate the manufacturing route of a particular delivered 993 rod. No heat-treatment recipe or hardness is given. Evidence status: manufacturer_declaration. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: General custom product offering. No individually confirmed titanium 993 part number, mass, heat treatment or endurance evidence is supplied; the standard 993-230-580-1270F product is 4340 steel.
